evidence: Receipt schema v1.0 (JSON Schema draft-07) has 10 required fields: module, phase, wave, timestamp, checks_run[], checks_passed[], evidence[], status (PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL), not_tested[], confidence (0.0-1.0). Optional fields: layer (enum L0-L8/shared), inputs[] (upstream receipt chain per I10 — each entry has module/receipt_path/staleness_state), outputs[], failure_reason (required when status FAIL or PARTIAL), revise_cycles (integer 0-3, max 3 per I4). Extension pattern: modules add top-level keys alongside base fields. not_tested is the anti-theater field — must be explicit, empty only when everything was verified. Supersedes receipt-schema-design-20260519 which incorrectly stated 8 required fields.
